extensionDescription.message: Cleans cookies and site data from Firefox containers.

popupLoading.description: Status message when the extension is loading the container list.

popupOptions.description: Menu item to open the extension's options screen.

popupCleanTooltip.message: Clean this container's cookies, localStorage, and IndexedDB
popupCleanTooltip.description: Tooltip for the container clean control.

popupPinTooltip.message: Pin this container to the top of the list
popupPinTooltip.description: Tooltip for the container pin control.

popupUnpinTooltip.message: Remove this container from the pinned section
popupUnpinTooltip.description: Tooltip for the container unpin control.

containerDefault.description: Name for the default Firefox container.

containerPrivate.description: Name for the private browsing Firefox container.

cleanConfirm.description: Status message when a further confirmation is requested to clean data.

cleanProgress.description: Status message when a clean operation is in progress.

cleanDone.description: Status message when a clean is complete.

cleanError.description: Status message when a clean operation fails. Instructs the user to check the extension's console for details.

appearance.description: Header text for the cosmetic options section.

appearanceDensityDefault.description: Label for the radio button to select default popup density.

appearanceDensityTouch.description: Label for the radio button to select large, touch-friendly popup density.

appearanceDensityContainer.description: Label for the container clean buttons used to demonstrate the different UI densities.

cleanShortcut.description: Header text for the keyboard shortcut clean feature.

cleanShortcutShortcut1.description: Keyboard shortcut description for clean shortcut 1.

cleanShortcutShortcut2.description: Keyboard shortcut description for clean shortcut 2.

cleanShortcutShortcut3.description: Keyboard shortcut description for clean shortcut 3.

cleanShortcutShortcut4.description: Keyboard shortcut description for clean shortcut 4.

cleanShortcutDescription.message: Clean containers using the keyboard shortcuts $SHORTCUTS$ for the extension. Each shortcut cleans a unique list of containers.
cleanShortcutDescription.description: Explanation text for the keyboard shortcut clean feature.

cleanShortcutDescriptionShortcutAnchor.description: Text for the link to the extension's shortcut settings.

cleanShortcutSelectLabel.description: Label text for the select menu to choose a clean shortcut to configure.

cleanShortcutSelect1.description: Select item text to modify clean shortcut 1.

cleanShortcutSelect2.description: Select item text to modify clean shortcut 2.

cleanShortcutSelect3.description: Select item text to modify clean shortcut 3.

cleanShortcutSelect4.description: Select item text to modify clean shortcut 4.

cleanShortcutSelectUnassigned.description: Select item substitution text when a shortcut clean does not have an assigned keyboard shortcut.

cleanShortcutRegex.description: Description text for regular expression input. Includes a warning that this feature is for advanced users.

cleanShortcutNotifyTitle.description: Title for the OS notification when activating a clean shortcut.

cleanShortcutNotifyMessage.description: Text for the OS notification when activating a clean shortcut.

importFromFile.description: Button text to import extension settings from a JSON file.

exportToFile.description: Button text to export extension settings to a downloadable JSON file.

importFromFileSuccessful.description: Status message after a successful JSON extension settings import.

importErrorNotJson.message: That file doesn't look like JSON.
importErrorNotJson.description: Error message when the imported options file does not appear to be valid JSON.

exportFilename.description: Default filename for the JSON settings export.
